'''''Cynosurus''''' is a genus of [[Eurasia]]n and [[North Africa]]n plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]]. Plants in this genus are known generally as '''dogstail grass'''. They are native to the Europe, the Azores, Algeria, Tunisia, Turkey, the [[Caucasus]], and Iran,<ref name = powo/> but some have been introduced into [[Australia]] as well as [[North America|North]] and [[South America]].<ref name=gm>Long, S. [http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Cynosurus&type=treatment ''Cynosurus'' L.] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110611122959/http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Cynosurus&type=treatment |date=2011-06-11 }} Grass Manual. Flora of North America.</ref><ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=108998 Flora of China Vol. 22 Page 245 <big>洋狗尾草属</big> yang gou wei cao shu ''Cynosurus'']</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Cynosurus Altervista Flora Italiana, genere ''Cynosurus'']</ref><ref>[https://plants.usda.gov/java/ClassificationServlet?source=profile&symbol=CYNOS2&display=31 United States Department of Agriculture Plants Profile]</ref>

==Species==
Three species are currently accepted.<ref name = powo/>
* ''[[Cynosurus cristatus]]'' <small>L.</small> - [[Europe]], [[Azores]], [[Caucasus]], [[Iran]], [[Turkey]]
* ''[[Cynosurus peltieri]]'' <small>Maire</small> - [[Algeria]], [[Tunisia]]
* ''[[Cynosurus polybracteatus]]'' <small>Poir.</small> - [[Algeria]], [[Tunisia]]

===Formerly included===
Numerous names have been coined using the name ''Cynosurus'', applied to species now regarded as better suited to other genera (''[[Aegopogon]], [[Apera]], [[Beckmannia]], [[Bouteloua]], [[Centotheca]], [[Chloris (plant)|Chloris]], [[Ciliochloa]], [[Coelachyrum]], [[Cynodon]], [[Dactyloctenium]], [[Desmostachya]], [[Dinebra]], [[Eleusine]], [[Enteropogon]], [[Falona]], [[Festuca]], [[Harpochloa]], [[Lamarckia]], [[Leptochloa]], [[Ochthochloa]], [[Oreochloa]], [[Polypogon]], [[Rostraria]], [[Sclerochloa]], [[Sesleria]], [[Sesleriella]], [[Tribolium (plant)|Tribolium]]'', and ''[[Wangenheimia]]'').
